D.dtype: bfloat16 base, unmerged enabled LoRA, float32 CPU head

plan.power: AC; pmset 68 W for every run; battery percentage and charging state recorded
plan.thermal: nominal at every row start; waits excluded from latency
plan.other_jobs: no build, test or other model job during measured processes
plan.timing_boundary: one render/tokenization, backbone, head/softmax and synchronized CPU result; prevalidation, load and thermal wait excluded
plan.instrumentation: External proc_pid_rusage at 100 ms for every condition; native internal sampler disabled; parent checks AC every two seconds
plan.load_observation: internal load phases recorded separately, not a cold-start ranking; no filesystem or model-cache purge
plan.limitations: Precision, LoRA merge and runtime differ between native and source; this measures the complete representations, not framework overhead alone.

temperatures.probability_comparison: Use T=1 for cross-representation probability differences; shipping probabilities use each representation's own calibration.

plan.timing_interpretation: Per-length values describe the fixed mixed-length sequence. B/C recycle before the first 100-token call of each measured round, so those rows include the reload and first-run costs. They are not same-shape steady-state timings.
plan.mixed_round_summary: Also report the sum of the four measured API times per round, excluding thermal waits, with n=6 rounds per condition.

A.reference: First measured A row for each token hash

quality_comparison.definitions: Agreement with the frozen teacher distribution, not real-world accuracy; descriptive comparison, no new acceptance criterion.

limitations: Fixed mixed-length sequence; B/C pay reload and first-run cost on each measured 100-token row.
Source BF16 plus unmerged LoRA versus native uint4 plus merged LoRA; not framework overhead alone.
Source retains an unused generation head in memory but does not forward it.
Nominal thermal state at row start does not imply constant temperature during inference.
No simultaneous builds, tests or model jobs; background CPU/GPU activity was not fully instrumented.
RSS and footprint are different counters; neither is an additional allocation to add to the other.
The footprint peak is the largest observed kernel lifetime counter; the final sampling gap is unobserved.
Load phase observations are not cold-start rankings; filesystem and model caches were not purged.
Each latency has six observations; no p95 or population-level speed guarantee.
